additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471368-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/SN313981068002] Multiple errors Issue CRM:03288000095
additional_info.body:
Dear Lara,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support. I hope you are doing well.
After reviewing the information and logs for your charger, I have analyzed the errors reported:
PilotState: E:
This indicates that the Electric Vehicle (EV) was not ready to initiate the charging
session
.
modbus0:
This was a temporary error related to the internet connection stability at that time.
Emergency Shutdown:
This was related with the main breaker, but the car session started, and the car was able to charge as normal.
LEM DC Meter Error:
While this is related to the charger’s internal components, our logs show that the system recovered automatically. Subsequent charging sessions started and operated normally, and the car charged until 100%
On this second screenshot we can see the percentage on the session.
We will continue to monitor the charger closely. If these errors persist, we will arrange for a
technician
to perform an on-site inspection
With best regards
,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
